title: Arctic Sea
safeHtml:
'''Arctic Sea''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central North Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-02.

History

The name of this Sub-District originates from Nazca Railway. The Namesake of this District originates from the Snowy Backdrop that the vicinity of this Station has provided, which also resembles a white Ocean.

At the time of the completion of Arctic Sea Station in 2020, and was already reserved in this Station, and when is also considered, that station had plans to feature four lines. This made Arctic Sea the immediate choice to become the core area of the entire Asylum District, complete with commercial buildings, large Shopping Malls, Topside Developments and even Administrative Facilities. However, subsequent redevelopment and personnel changes have caused all commercial and administrative facilities to relocate to Brighton Hall. With the exception of Arctic Sea Hospital, which remained unaffected despite changes in plans, all shopping malls and their corresponding Topside Developments have been downsized.

It should be noted that Kam Leung Estate, despite being located in the Melody Sub-District, is administered by this Sub-District, and can be seen as an Exclave of this Sub-District within the Melody Sub-District.

title: Asylum
safeHtml:
'''Asylum''' is one of the Main Districts in Los Sengas. It is represented by Lavender, and became District Number 29 on November 22 2020.

History

At the end of 2024, the current developer of Asylum has been invited back to Los Sengas to assist in its development, and obtained development rights of Asylum. At the time, there are three developers and planners within Asylum, and Arctic Sea was planned to be its town center, with development gradually radiating from its surroundings with mixed land use.

However, by the beginning of 2025, one of the three developers was suspended from the server, and with the other remaining developer being occupied with affairs from other servers, there was only one person left to develop and construct Asylum. Therefore, the decision was made to scrap the original plans and changed it in such a way that the district would resemble a Hong Kong-styled New Town in an attempt to balance out the population between West and East Los Sengas, as well as to complete the dreams of the main developer. While initial plans only expected Asylum to have a popluation of 400'000, the final population of Asylum was expanded to 2.5 million people, which includes the 300 thousand people within the Winsol expansion area. Development of Asylum is inspired by Peckern North and East New Territories of Hong Kong, in particular Tai Po District, the North District and Ma On Shan. It should also be noted that all the Sub-Districts and Place Names within Asylum are provided by the current developer to commemorate the people that he met on his musical endeavors.

In the latest incarnation, the town center of Asylum is relocated from Arctic Sea to Brighton Hall, which is also in turn the administrative center of Asylum. Subsequent Plans released by Nazca Railway has further emphasized the importance of Brighton Hall within the District. However, due to its relatively far distance from East Asylum, the were plans for Fine Woods to become the "East Capital" of Asylum in order to serve residents who live to the east of Route 3. However, due to personal reasons, Fine Woods only featured a Wet Market and a large Stadium, as well as a Performance Arena larger than Asylum City Hall.

Besides of the Town Center Relocation, some districts have also been renamed, with Stronglad East being renamed as Hawynveil, Stronglad West being renamed as Stronglad, and Blufield being renamed as Huntington. While Fine Woods had also undergone considerations of renaming, plans to rename that district was ultimately scrapped due to fierce opposition.

In response to the construction of Winter Point Gateway, as well as guaranteeing better connections between Asylum and Winsol, the developer of Asylum has intended to develop Winsol alongside Asylum and had received approval. As a result, Route 18 now extends to the east of Winsol, and has considered Winsol to the north of Route 18 part of the Asylum New Town, which would later become the Vermillion Stone, Mayfair Garden and Maritime Vista Sub-Districts.

After 7 months and 15 days, Asylum completed development on July 15 2025, and will undergo improvement works when Nazca Railway eventually reaches this district, such as adding pedestrian facilities and green infrastructure for housing estates that were completed during early stages of the development, as well as adding public houses at its border with Snowty when Nazca Railway adds stations on said boundary.

History (Fictious)

In the 1970's, Terracept has undergone a Civil War, and many asylum seekers have made their way to Los Sengas, casuing the population to surge from 2.3 million in the mid 70's to 3.3 million by the late 70's. On average, up to 700 people entered Los Sengas through One-way Permit or other legal means. Meanwhile, as many existing areas had scandals regarding build quality of public housing and needed reconstruction as a result, there exists a very severe shortage of housing in Los Sengas. Meanwhile, plans for the Los Sengas International and Intergalactic Transport Hub (Also known as the SITH) have been announced in the early 1980's, and with plans to build Satellite Cities to complement development of the SITH, it has been decided that large-scale development would take place in the mid-northern Ingress Continent after consultation with other local residents, which includes this district, north Winsol and southeast Snowty in order to support the large influx of asylum seekers. Meanwhile, a large CBD is also built at Winter Pointto facilitate foreign relations. By 1994, the first batch of residents have entered Asylum, and local residents also managed to settle in several of the various Public Housing Estates.

After a decade of development, Seaside Broadwalk finally began sales in 2008, and housing development within the district has slowed down. By now, half of the residents in Asylum are migrants from terracept, and among these residents, a sizable proportion of them are also affected by the Public Housing Scandal.

  • The Station Title of this Station is '''Razor's Edge'''.
  • This Stations features The Cuisine, and the Station Menu is "Beef Sliders with Pickles and Mustard".
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Of Soil and Splendor, Of Jest and Joy".

Station Souvenir Hints

  • Stars: 2
  • Take Note of the axes in the station and determine in descending order the heights of the axes.
  • The password leading to the Station Souvenir is clicked in the first letter of the above words.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of an iron axe.

Station Gauntlet

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
  • Solo
  • Flow
  • Sequence

Hints

  • Stars: 1.5-2
  • Take note of the Platform Numbers indicated by the two hints to determine the order of the two sets of tools involved.
  • In accordance to the Platform Number at the hint, determine the order of each set of tool.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of an iron hoe.

Fourth Anniversary Souvenir Hints

  • Stars: 0
  • Just walk to the Platfor 2 Lobby and get your souvenir.

Fun Facts

  • This Station mainly uses elevators to traverse between the concourse between the Ground Level Concourse and the Platforms. With 16 elevators, and 8 elevators for each platform, this station has the most elevators besides of Metropolis Terminal at the time of its construction.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G1G4tPbraYo&t=586s</ref>
  • Passengers enter the elevators from the sides and leave the elevators from the center. This Arrangement of Elevators alludes to HKU Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G1G4tPbraYo&t=620s</ref>
  • The Concourse of this station has been expanded during the Upgrading Works.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G1G4tPbraYo&t=675s</ref>
